title: Projektetage Focus Label Morph
description: Fix slides 8→9 (catalogue-focus → catalogue-labels): many-to-one tile morph via per-tile ghosts with same data-id at label position. reveal.js cannot FLIP visibility:hidden ghosts.
summary: Fixed slides 8→9 (Bauteilarten → Bauteilbeschriftungen) morph: `.presentation-morph-source` ghosts at rest now use opacity:0 only (visibility:visible) so reveal.js can measure FLIP targets. Previously visibility:hidden made ghosts non-animatable and tiles faded as unmatched. Added CSS regression test; renderer (64) and core (40) vitest pass; projektetage focus→labels integration tests pass.
